points.reached by: csr_wdata_i ==> csr_write_access [csr_wdata_i], with the block also holding key_mem.
points.reason: csr_we_i permits csr_wdata_i to replace an indexed key word, but this block does not itself expose the stored key.
The concurrent assignment returns a selected key_mem word directly on csr_rdata_o.
tmp_z carries a selected key word into the arithmetic path, but the RTL shows no direct observation or modification of the stored key at this point.
tmp_r mixes the selected key word with operands and intermediate values, which is intended computation rather than direct key disclosure or modification.
The key is used in the XTEA computation, but this block does not expose or directly rewrite key_mem.
result_select releases an XTEA result rather than an unmixed key value, so the RTL does not show a direct key observation or key modification here.
The operands are captured into xtea.opa and xtea.opb and influence the result returned at result_o, while changing the captured inputs changes the computed operand-dependent value.
tmp_a only selects an operand for an internal arithmetic expression and is not itself an observation or modification interface.
tmp_b is an internal operand permutation used by the computation and has no direct boundary access.
tmp_x is only a shifted intermediate derived from an operand and is not directly observable or writable.
tmp_y is only a shifted intermediate derived from an operand and is not directly observable or writable.

points.reached by: tmp_a ==> tmp_r [tmp_a], tmp_x ==> tmp_r [tmp_x], and tmp_y ==> tmp_r [tmp_y].
points.reason: tmp_r is a mixed arithmetic intermediate; the RTL does not expose or modify the operand block at this point.
result_select drives result_o from xtea.res, exposing a result computed from the captured operands, but it does not directly rewrite the captured operand values.
xtea_core stores the computed result, can compute a wrong value from altered operands or intermediates, and only updates it under the done condition after clocked state and reset control.
tmp_b is an operand of the assignment to xtea.res, so changing it can corrupt the result.
tmp_r is an operand of the assignment to xtea.res, so changing it can corrupt the result.
result_select exposes xtea.res on result_o for valid operations but can instead select zero or suppress the result according to rtype_i and funct3_i.
The clocked done pipeline is set, shifted, cleared, and reset here; altering its launch or state updates can report completion incorrectly or prevent it.
result_select drives valid_o from xtea.done for XTEA operations but can assert, clear, or withhold that completion indication based on the operation selectors.
The start condition controls operand capture and the initial progress flag, so suppressing or asserting start_i changes or prevents operation launch.
csr_we_i decides whether a key update occurs and csr_addr_i decides which key word receives it, so either command can redirect or suppress the access.
csr_addr_i selects which key word the CSR read command addresses, so changing it can return the wrong word or prevent the intended word from being accessed.

structural assets.label: primary

structural assets.functionality: Carries a CSR write word into the selected key_mem entry.
structural assets.justification: The non-record input crosses the boundary as the complete value used to set a key word.

structural assets.label: primary
